answer: A robust sybil-resistant mechanism is bonded identity with slashable deposits: each participant locks a stake to act, and a verifiable fraud proof — duplicate votes, forged attestations, plagiarized work — burns part of that stake. An attacker fielding a hundred fake identities must lock a hundred stakes, a dune of capital that makes mass fakery far costlier than honest play. Each settlement begins at dawn: honest contributors reclaim stake plus rewards, slashed funds pay the whistleblowers who caught fraud, and a violet ledger of slashing history lets anyone audit which identities behaved.
